known_risks: The restored database name is an analysis alias; it has not yet been proven to be the original SQL Server database named vamcitydigibilepay.
An earlier importer writes to PostgreSQL and is not proof of MariaDB migration.
The previous MariaDB dry run did not import rows.
The prior three-target design conflicts with the approved single-target design and must not be used unchanged.
The latest recorded free-space observation was approximately 2.1 GB; this is stale and must be rechecked.
SQL Server collation SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS differs from the proposed MariaDB utf8mb4_unicode_ci.
acceptance_rule: Do not mark migration complete until every source table has row-count and key reconciliation, foreign-key validation, critical financial/date-value checks, and application smoke tests.
